entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, yes. I have an order and... I think I need to return something. I'm a little lost on how to do it.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Sure, it's David Chen, order number 788-4B2. It's about the jersey I bought.
Okay, thank you, David. I see the order here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
It's just the wrong size. I tried it on and it's way too tight across the chest. I must have misread the sizing chart, it was all a bit overwhelming. I'd like to get a larger one.
I see. So it's just a preference on the fit, no technical fault or anything like that?
Right, no, it's a great jersey, just not on me. I really need to do an exchange. The website was confusing... can't you just help me?

Of course, David. That's what I'm here for. Let me just check the policy... Okay, it looks like you received the item 39 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely process an exchange for you.
Oh, really? That's fantastic! I was so worried I had missed the deadline. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email now. Just send the jersey that's too tight back to us, and as soon as it's scanned by the carrier, we'll ship out the next size up. Does that work for you?
Yes, that's perfect. That's so much easier. Thank you, Sarah.
Happy to help, David. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
You're welcome. Have a great day and thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
